technique_name: Create an OpEd on the topic of digital rights.
description: The proliferation of technology has changed the way we interact with one another, and it has led to an increased demand for greater digital rights. Technology has created an enormous amount of data, which has been monetized by companies that can legally gain access to it through regulations and contracts.
